findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation before granting document reads
findings.body: When `userTenant !== documentTenant`, `canReadDocument` now returns `true`. Callers relying on this function for tenant isolation can therefore expose documents across tenants.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant matching before granting document reads
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now authorizes every request. Any input where `userTenant !== documentTenant` returns `true`, allowing cross-tenant document access and creating an authorization bypass.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation before authorizing document reads
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now authorizes every request. Any caller relying on it for tenant isolation will allow a user to read another tenant’s documents whenever `userTenant !== documentTenant`, causing a cross-tenant authorization bypass and data exposure.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
